fullDescription: A deep-teal, Inter-set newsletter capture CTA (newsletter simple left): a two-column section with a value headline on the left and an inline email field + Subscribe button, privacy line, and avatar social proof on the right, anchored by a sticky nav, an eyebrow context band, and a footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
A full-width newsletter capture CTA section ('newsletter simple left') anchored inside a real marketing page: deep-teal brand accent on a near-white slate canvas, Inter typeface throughout. Left column carries the value proposition headline + supporting line; right column carries an inline email field + Subscribe button, a privacy/trust line, and a light avatar-stack social-proof row. A sticky translucent nav sits on top and an eyebrow-badged context band ('The dispatch') above the CTA makes it read as a page section rather than a floating card.

## Estilo Visual
Use the Inter typeface (400/500/600/700/800) with antialiased rendering and tight tracking on headings. Build a near-white slate neutral system — page background #f8fafc (ink-50), section panels pure white #ffffff, body text #475569 (ink-600) and muted #64748b (ink-500), strong headings #0f172a (ink-900), borders #e2e8f0 (ink-200) and inputs #cbd5e1 (ink-300). Use ONE saturated accent, deep teal: primary #0f766e (teal-700) for the logo mark, primary buttons, links and the eyebrow badge text; hover #115e59 (teal-800); soft fills #f0fdfa (teal-50) and #ccfbf1 (teal-100); glow/accents #5eead4 (teal-300) and #2dd4bf (teal-400). Buttons and inputs are h-12 with rounded-xl corners and a small colored shadow (shadow-teal-700/25). Add quiet atmosphere on the CTA section only: a radial dot-grid background (radial-gradient circle rgba(15,118,110,0.10) 1px, 22px tile) and one blurred teal glow orb (bg-teal-300/25, blur-3xl) in the top-right, plus a thin left-to-right teal gradient hairline along the section's top edge. Keep shadows soft and small; no neon, no busy gradients.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with a translucent backdrop-blur background (bg-ink-50/85) and a bottom hairline border (border-ink-200/70). Inside a max-w-6xl, h-16, items justified between: left = a 32px rounded-lg teal-700 logo tile with a white sparkle icon + bold 'Promptframe' wordmark; center/right = horizontal nav links (Library, Canvas, Pricing, Changelog) in ink-600 medium that darken to ink-900 on hover, hidden on mobile; far right = a text 'Sign in' link plus a solid teal-700 'Start free' button (rounded-lg, white, semibold).

### Context band (eyebrow + headline)
A centered intro section on a pure-white panel with a bottom border, max-w-6xl, py-20/24. Top: a pill eyebrow badge (rounded-full, border-teal-200, bg-teal-50, uppercase tracking-wider text-xs, teal-700) with a small envelope icon reading 'The dispatch'. Then an extrabold balanced headline (~3xl/4xl, ink-900, leading-tight) and a muted ink-500 supporting paragraph (max-w-xl), all center-aligned.

### CTA two-column grid
The anchor section on the ink-50 dot-grid canvas, py-20/28, max-w-6xl. A grid that is 1 column on mobile and 2 columns on lg (lg:grid-cols-2), vertically centered, with generous column gap (gap-x-20). LEFT column: an extrabold headline ~2rem→2.75rem (ink-900, leading ~1.08, tight tracking) e.g. 'Sign up for the design dispatch', and a larger muted ink-600 paragraph (text-lg, max-w-md). RIGHT column: the capture form (see components) plus the privacy line and social-proof row stacked beneath it.

### Footer band
A slim footer on a white panel with a top border, max-w-6xl, py-8, text-sm ink-500. Left: a 24px rounded-md teal-700 tile with a small white sparkle + 'Promptframe' wordmark (ink-700 semibold). Right: a copyright line '© 2026 Promptframe. Built for people who ship.' Stacks vertically on mobile, row on sm+.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A responsive form that is a vertical stack on mobile and a horizontal row on sm+ (flex-col → sm:flex-row, gap-3). The email field is a flex-1 white rounded-xl input group with an ink-300 border, a leading ink-400 envelope icon, and an h-12 transparent email input with ink-400 placeholder 'Enter your email' and no default outline. The whole field group shows a focus ring on focus-within: a 4px soft teal halo (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(15,118,110,0.12)) and the border turns teal-700. Next to it, a solid teal-700 'Subscribe' button (h-12, rounded-xl, white semibold, small teal shadow, hover teal-800) with a trailing arrow-right icon.

### Componente
A small ink-500 text-sm line directly under the form with a leading ink-400 lock icon: 'We care about your data. Read our privacy policy.' — where 'privacy policy' is a teal-700 link, medium weight, underlined with a teal-300 decoration and underline-offset, darkening to teal-800 on hover.

### Componente
A light social-proof row below the privacy line: three overlapping 28px circular avatars (-space-x-2, each with a 2px ink-50 ring) using initials on teal-700 / teal-600 / ink-800 fills, followed by an ink-500 line 'Joined by 8,400+ designers and builders.' with the count bolded in ink-700.

### Componente
A rounded-full pill with a teal-200 border, teal-50 fill, an inline envelope icon and uppercase, wide-tracked, text-xs teal-700 label — used as the section eyebrow.

## Notas Especiais
Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:envelope-simple, ph:envelope-simple-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:lock-simple). The single deep-teal accent doing all the work against a quiet slate-neutral page is the core of the look — do not introduce a second accent hue. The CTA is intentionally framed by a nav, an eyebrow context band, and a footer so it reads as a section of a living page, not an isolated card; keep that framing when transferring the style. Atmosphere (dot-grid + one blurred teal glow + the top gradient hairline) lives only on the CTA section. All copy uses no em-dashes.

style.description: Modern SaaS / dev-tool editorial aesthetic: restrained slate-ink neutrals with a single saturated deep-teal accent (#0f766e), Inter at extrabold weights for headlines, generous whitespace, soft shadows, large rounded corners (rounded-xl / 0.75rem), and subtle atmospheric touches (radial dot-grid + a blurred teal glow) instead of heavy gradients. Antialiased text, tight tracking on headings.

layout_and_structure.description: Three stacked full-bleed bands inside a centered max-w-6xl container (px-6): (1) a sticky top nav, (2) a centered context band introducing the newsletter, (3) the CTA section itself as a two-column grid that reflows to one column on mobile, then a slim footer band. The CTA is the anchor; the bands above/below give it page context.
